user_query: My family has a private Minecraft server and we want to make sure that no mods on the blocklist for reposts are used. Could you please provide me with the blocklist in plain text, YAML, and JSON formats? It would be great if we can also fetch the blocklist from the hosts file in XML format.

TaskList.description: Fetch the blocklist in plain text format.
Convert the blocklist fetched in step 1 to YAML format.
Convert the blocklist fetched in step 1 to JSON format.
Fetch the blocklist from the hosts file in XML format.
